lason: Lason brings MMONN together with Alisson Shore and Because on a three-artist hip-hop release. First released as a single on September 14, 2025, it also appears as the second track on Alisson Shore’s Memento Mori. The collaboration sits within an album that explores love, loss and transformation.
ply4-remix: MMONN revisits PLY4 with DEMI, turning his original 2023 solo release into a shared record. Released in June 2025, this version is written and performed by both artists, with production credited to CRMDRM. Plumberboi handles the arrangement, mixing and mastering, while DEMI’s official video presents the collaboration as PLY4 (Remix).
chillerong-busy: Released in September 2023, Chillerong Busy brings MMONN and Lanzeta together around the push and pull of everyday work. Its lyrics balance ambition with rest, moving between the pressure to keep going and the need to slow down. The song makes room for family, personal goals and a calmer pace without giving up on the work ahead.
pagod-na: Pagod Na pairs MMONN with RB Slatt on a single released in November 2022. Across their verses, the two voices trace a relationship worn down by hurt and the exhaustion of holding on. The song moves toward separation and letting go, giving both performers a place in its account of heartbreak.
kung-kakapit-ka: Released on December 27, 2024, Kung Kakapit Ka pairs MMONN with featured artist Ne7in. The R&B/Soul single unfolds over three minutes and 52 seconds. Its official lyric video accompanies the release with visuals credited to Orcaworldwide.
amarad: Amarad brings MMONN and featured artist kyleaux together on an R&B single released in September 2026. Issued on the MMONN label, the track runs for three minutes and 24 seconds. Its release credits name Mmonen Moreno as both producer and composer.
